lines.text: Jehoahaz son of Jehu reigns seventeen years in Samaria, does evil, and the LORD delivers Israel to Hazael of Aram.
Jehoahaz seeks the LORD's favor, the LORD gives Israel a deliverer, and Aram leaves him only ten chariots.
Jehoahaz is buried in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoash becomes king and walks in Jeroboam's sins.
Elisha tells Jehoash to strike the ground, and he strikes it three times, so Elisha is pleased with him.
Israelites fleeing raiders throw a man's body into Elisha's tomb, and the man revives when he touches Elisha's bones.
